'''Ran-Siij''' was a [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Ran-Siij was a member of a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] that were led by the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Koll Jovas]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the bounty hunters were hired by a member of the [[Metatheran Cartel]] to find whoever was responsible for some attacks on Cartel shipping in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]; upon finding those responsible, the bounty hunters were to stop them. When the bounty hunters arrived in the Cularin system in their [[Transport/Legends|transport]], it was shot down by a [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] under the command of the [[pirate group]] [[Rock Rogues]]&mdash;the same group responsible for the attacks. The bounty hunters' transport crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]; Ran-Siij and the other bounty hunters climbed out of the wreckage, determined to find the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].

Shortly after, the bounty hunters encountered the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&mdash;a group of freelance agents who were also investigating the Rock Rogues. Jovas, Ran-Siij and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sina Voosha]] approached the heroes and Jovas introduced himself, while the other bounty hunters hid nearby.
